name: StockControls – Inventory Management for WooCommerce
author: Plugins.shop

sections.description:
Manage WooCommerce inventory in one workspace. Review stock corrections, CSV updates and supplier deliveries before applying changes.

Free includes stock editing, CSV imports and exports, movement history, suppliers, purchase orders, PDF documents and full or partial receiving. These tools need no account, license or external service.

Try the live demo | Read the guides | Get support

Bulk stock editing

Find products and variations by name, SKU or ID. Filter inventory and save views. Set quantities or add and subtract units across selected products, with a reason and preview. Changed stock needs a fresh review.

CSV stock imports and inventory exports

Match spreadsheet rows by product ID or SKU, map columns and validate before importing. Larger imports can resume after interruption. Export filtered inventory and stock history for reports; use the separate import template for updates.

Stock history and low-stock checks

See recorded quantities before and after a change, reasons, users, sources and times. Follow supported WooCommerce stock events. Find low-stock products and edit thresholds; WooCommerce handles its normal low-stock emails on qualifying order events. StockControls manual edits, imports and purchase-order receipts do not send those alerts themselves.

Suppliers, purchase orders and receiving

Keep supplier contacts, product references and lead times. Create purchase orders with costs, delivery dates, PDF, print and CSV documents. Receive six of ten units now and leave four outstanding. Amend or cancel outstanding quantities while retaining received stock and history.

When Pro helps

The separate Pro add-on adds saved stocktakes, variance review, team and blind counts, replenishment suggestions, supplier comparisons and buying baskets. Sidebar Pro previews can be switched off.

Related plugins from Plugins.shop

Optional companion plugins from the same publisher:

  • OrderWorth – review cost of goods and estimated order profit.
  • OrderFloor – set minimum orders, quantity limits and pack sizes.
  • Logged.ai – investigate supported WordPress and WooCommerce activity.

Privacy

StockControls stores movement quantities, sources, WordPress actor IDs, reasons, supplier contacts, purchasing documents, receipt links, saved counts, private import source/results, saved views and local setup/warning preferences in the local store database. Imports and local PDF generation do not contact an external service. Authorized users can export records. Avoid unnecessary personal information in reasons and retain downloaded records appropriately.

External services and optional welcome choices

Free needs no account or external license. Welcome & privacy appears after a first eligible manual activation, with separate unchecked choices. Skip and saving neither choice send nothing; all Free tools remain available.

If selected, compatibility sharing sends your site domain (not its path), WordPress/PHP versions and site language to https://stockcontrols.com/newsletter-api/v1/plugin-welcome/. The independent newsletter choice sends your entered email and installed Free/Pro edition to that same service. Requests include a random connection ID, protected reporting token and consent version. The service receives the network address and records consent/report times. No customer, stock, order or supplier data is sent. Selected data refreshes at most weekly; email edition changes can refresh after an hour. A changed site URL pauses sharing.

New email subscriptions require confirmation. Tips and release news use a weekly schedule; occasional Pro offers can use the reported Free edition. Article emails, purchase personalization and campaign-link tracking start off. Existing subscriptions/preferences are preserved. Stop each sharing choice in Welcome & privacy; a failed removal can be retried. Confirmed subscriptions are separate: use Unsubscribe or Email preferences in a newsletter.

Reports expire after 90 days without activity, pending requests after 48 hours, confirmed subscriptions after at most 730 days; consent/suppression records may remain 180 days. Connection controls expire 90 days after the last accepted report; cancelling an existing connection does not extend this period. A cancellation received before enrollment may retain a minimal prevention record for up to 90 days. Cleanup scheduling, outages and backups affect physical deletion. Deactivation pauses reporting. Uninstall removes local welcome details without sending a request: stop sharing first to request remote removal. The service privacy policy is https://stockcontrols.com/privacy/. Optional welcome reporting and newsletter choices are explained at https://stockcontrols.com/newsletter/privacy. Paid Pro purchases have separate terms at https://stockcontrols.com/checkout/terms. Full data flow and WordPress privacy-tool behavior are described in README.md.

Bundled PDF software

PDFs use locally bundled, privately namespaced mPDF and DejaVu Sans. The combined distribution is GPL-2.0-only; original StockControls code remains GPL-2.0-or-later. Third-party notices and build documentation are included in development/pdf-dependencies/.
sections.installation:
1. Back up your store. Use WooCommerce 9.1+, WordPress 6.5+ and PHP 7.4+.
  2. In Plugins > Add New, search for StockControls and install and activate it on the individual site.
  3. Open StockControls > Settings > Setup & health, then Inventory. Enable Manage stock on products you want to adjust.

Test on staging. Standard WooCommerce storage, MySQL/MariaDB named locks and InnoDB tables are required. Network activation and custom product data stores are unsupported.

Update Free before Pro without uninstalling. Pro 1.1.29 requires Free 1.1.29. For the old stockcontrols folder, follow the migration steps in documentation.txt.
sections.faq:
Does it support variable products?

Yes, including variations using parent stock. Stock adjustments resolve the stock-owning product. For a purchase order, select the parent when a variation shares its stock; variations with their own stock can be selected directly. Fractional quantities require matching WooCommerce precision support.

How large can a stock CSV import be?

Mapped imports accept 200 rows / 1 MB; large imports accept 10,000 rows / 10 MB with exact headers. Invalid rows block approval. Applying can partly succeed: reopen the same job after interruption. See the CSV guide and documentation.txt for limits and recovery.

Does stock history include every change?

It records StockControls changes and supported WooCommerce hooks from activation onward. Initial quantities and enabling or disabling stock tracking establish a baseline; they do not create an opening movement. Direct database writes can bypass it. External recording is best effort; detected failures raise a notice without stopping checkout. History is not a tamper-proof ledger.

Can I save a stocktake or scan barcodes?

Free includes SKU lookup and immediate corrections. Saved counts and reconciliation require Pro. Keyboard scanners can type SKUs; saved-count scanning requires Pro. Camera scanning and barcode labels are not included.

Does it place supplier orders automatically?

No. Send downloaded purchase orders through your existing supplier process. Warehouse allocation, cross-store synchronization, supplier email automation and accounting integration are not included.

Does it support HPOS and PDF purchase orders?

HPOS compatibility is declared. Local PDFs need PHP mbstring, GD and writable temporary storage. Unsupported characters return an error; browser Print / Save as PDF remains available. See documentation.txt for font coverage.

What happens when I deactivate or uninstall?

Records stay by default. Optional history deletion has recovery safeguards; suppliers, purchasing, saved counts and large imports remain. Review documentation.txt for retention and removal, including uploaded import data. Stop optional sharing before uninstalling to request remote removal.
sections.changelog:
1.1.29

  • Prevent a false stock-history warning when WooCommerce saves an unchanged, untracked variation quantity; genuine observation failures still warn.
  • Add an explicit way to remove a primary supplier while preserving planning details and existing purchase orders.
  • Improve mobile table guidance, keyboard navigation, unsaved Settings feedback, saved-view panels and CSV upload messages.
  • Clarify receipt previews, show exact purchase-order line totals and clean up site-specific display preferences when history deletion is permitted.

1.1.28

  • Preserve validated numeric CSV quantities while retaining formula protection for text.
  • Improve quantity formatting, history filter feedback, purchasing on phones and workflow navigation.
  • Find editable draft products in purchase-order searches and reject oversized large CSV files earlier.
  • Clarify stock baselines, shared-stock purchasing and low-stock notification scope.

1.1.27

  • Harden CSV exports against formula prefixes hidden behind Unicode characters. Recent work now fills pages with verified records and offers continuation for longer searches; only verified owned records count toward the displayed page limit. Stock quantities and ownership checks are unchanged.

Earlier release notes are included in changelog.txt.
